thread:
alice-dev: quick check — running into a weird 401 when streaming with the node SDK inside WSL -> docker. Works locally on mac. anyone seen api key/env newline weirdness?
ben: can you paste how you're setting the header? streaming usually fails if Authorization header has extra char.
alice-dev: using .env, KEY=abc123 (no quotes), then Dockerfile copies .env and node process reads process.env.KEY and we do `Authorization: Basic ${Buffer.from(`${process.env.KEY}:`).toString('base64')}`. curl direct -> ok, sdk stream -> 401.
sam-ml: hm `Buffer.from(key + ':')` is fine normally. maybe `.env` got CRLF or hidden BOM. try `cat -v .env` or `xxd -p -c 256 .env` in the container to check.
alice-dev: did that, saw trailing `^M` in cat -v. guess WSL/dos newline.
ben: yep. quick fix in Dockerfile: `RUN sed -i -e 's/\r$//' /app/.env` or during build `tr -d '\r' < .env > .env.lf`.
alice-dev: thanks. quick followup — is there a recommended SDK helper to avoid this? streaming reconnect might re-use cached header and fail idempotently.
sam-ml: we added a tiny helper in the SDK to normalize keys: `normalizeApiKey(k) { return k.replace(/\s+/g, '').replace(/\r/g, '') }` — but it's not default for env var reading because some customers intentionally have spaces. we sanitize for Basic auth path though.
ben: also note: when using Basic auth with an empty password we include the trailing colon before base64 — `key:` -> base64. If you accidentally trim the colon you get different token and 401.
alice-dev: good call. I had a `trim()` that accidentally removed the colon in one place in our wrapper. fixed.
infra-bot: deploy noted: staging rolled back after 3 failed streaming auth attempts (request-id: rq_3f2b).
ben: for future debugging, logging snippet we use: `console.log('auth-header-b64', Buffer.from(k + ':').toString('base64'))` and compare with curl `echo -n 'KEY:' | base64`. also `kubectl exec` into container and `node -e "console.log(process.env.KEY.split('').map(c=>c.charCodeAt(0)))"` to inspect hidden chars.
alice-dev: re-tested, streaming reconnected fine after removing CRLF and fixing trim. thanks y'all :thumbsup: 
sam-ml: fyi, will open tiny SDK PR to add optional normalize flag for env-based creds so we don't silently change values for file-based secrets. reviewer ping @ben when I have the branch.
ben: ping received. if you want fast patch consider adding a small test that constructs header from "KEY\r" input and asserts 401 -> corrected -> 200, just so we don't regress.
alice-dev: perfect — much better than flailing in prod logs. closing the loop.
